claims.claim: DVD achieves 74.2% on LVBench without transcripts and 76.0% with transcripts.
DVD delivers a 17.1% absolute gain over its base VLM OpenAI o3 (57.1%).
Replacing o3 with GPT-4o causes a 13.7% collapse (76.0% to 62.3%).
DeepSeek-R1 achieves 68.5% within the DVD framework, outperforming proprietary GPT-4o.
DVD reaches 76.6% on EgoSchema, surpassing human-level accuracy (~76%).
